boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented Saint Mary’s study environments, including the interim library and academic spaces with clear use details.

cards.title: Power Plant Drop-In Space
cards.subtitle: Interim library near Brousseau Hall
cards.notes: Use the lobby’s lounge seats for a flexible solo work session; confirm the interim library’s current opening hours before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A limited, informal study area inside the College’s temporary library hub.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary’s states that limited drop-in study space is available in the Power Plant, including lounge seats in the lobby.
cards.source_title: Library Services and Support at the Power Plant
cards.access_notes: The Power Plant library is open only to current SMC students, staff, and faculty; check the Library Hours page before visiting.

cards.title: Power Plant Silent Study Zone
cards.subtitle: Interim library near Brousseau Hall
cards.notes: Choose an individual cubicle in this designated silent room when you need focused reading or writing with fewer distractions.
cards.short_summary: A quiet Power Plant room with individual cubicle workspaces.
cards.evidence_claim: The College identifies a Silent Study Zone room in the Power Plant with several individual cubicle spaces.
cards.source_title: Library Services and Support at the Power Plant
cards.access_notes: Restricted to current SMC students, staff, and faculty; visit during published interim library hours.

cards.title: Power Plant Sensory Room
cards.subtitle: Interim library near Brousseau Hall
cards.notes: Reserve this room in advance if a lower-stimulation setup and soft seating would help you reset before returning to coursework.
cards.short_summary: A reservable sensory-focused room within the interim library.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary’s Library lists a sensory room among the reservable spaces in the Power Plant.
cards.source_title: Library Services and Support at the Power Plant
cards.access_notes: Reserve online up to one week ahead; the interim library is limited to current SMC students, staff, and faculty.

cards.title: Power Plant Reservable Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Interim library near Brousseau Hall
cards.notes: Book one of the library’s four study rooms online up to a week ahead when your group needs a defined place to work.
cards.short_summary: Four bookable group-work rooms in the temporary library.
cards.evidence_claim: The Library has four reservable study rooms in the Power Plant, with online reservations available up to a week in advance.
cards.source_title: Library Services and Support at the Power Plant
cards.access_notes: Online reservation is required; interim library access is for current SMC students, staff, and faculty.

cards.entity_name: Marie Curie STEM Center Main Study Room
cards.title: Marie Curie STEM Center Main Study Room
cards.subtitle: Marie Curie STEM Center
cards.notes: Bring a problem set or tutoring question and use the whiteboard tables for collaborative STEM work or one-to-one tutoring.
cards.short_summary: A STEM-focused room set up with whiteboard tables and academic support.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary’s says the Marie Curie STEM Center’s main study room has whiteboard tables for small groups and one-to-one tutoring.
cards.access_notes: The Center offers STEM peer tutoring during its listed tutoring hours; verify the current schedule before going.

cards.entity_name: Marie Curie STEM Center Small-Group Study Rooms
cards.title: Marie Curie STEM Center Small-Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Marie Curie STEM Center
cards.notes: Use the SMART-equipped small-group rooms to share material with a project team, then check current tutoring-hour availability before arrival.
cards.short_summary: Two small-group spaces equipped with SMART technology.
cards.evidence_claim: The Marie Curie STEM Center has two small-group study rooms equipped with SMART technology.
cards.access_notes: Students may access Center resources during tutoring hours; confirm availability with the STEM Center.

cards.title: Psychology Center Central Lounge
cards.subtitle: Psychology Center
cards.notes: Set up at a couch or table in the central lounge for reading or a quiet partner session, while keeping the academic setting in mind.
cards.short_summary: A lounge with couches and tables at the center of the Psychology Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary’s describes the Psychology Center’s central lounge as having couches and tables where students gather to study and socialize.
cards.access_notes: Located in an academic department building; access may vary with building hours and College operations.

cards.title: Galileo Hall Student Study Spaces
cards.subtitle: Galileo Hall
cards.notes: Look for the physics, math, and computer science study areas in Galileo Hall when working near those disciplines or meeting classmates.
cards.short_summary: Academic study areas in a science building that also houses classrooms and physics labs.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary’s says Galileo Hall has student communities and study spaces for physics, math, and computer science students.
cards.access_notes: Located in Galileo Hall; use is subject to building access and any department-space policies.

cards.title: Math Pedagogy Center
cards.subtitle: Galileo Hall
cards.notes: Use this Galileo Hall study destination when preparing math coursework, and check with the department if you need program-specific assistance.
cards.short_summary: A named mathematics learning space within Galileo Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary’s lists the Math Pedagogy Center among Galileo Hall’s physics, math, and computer science student study spaces.
cards.access_notes: Located in Galileo Hall; verify building access and Center availability before visiting.

cards.title: Aquinas Hall Study Lounge
cards.subtitle: Aquinas Hall Honors Living Community
cards.notes: If you live in the Honors Living Community, use the first-floor study lounge for a close-to-home work session between classes.
cards.short_summary: A first-floor study lounge in the Honors Living Community residence hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary’s identifies a study lounge on the first floor of Aquinas Hall, home to the Honors Living Community.
cards.access_notes: This is a residential facility serving the Honors Living Community; access is limited to authorized residents and guests.
